name: must-be-the-stack
postCreateCommand: gem install bundler && npm install -g pnpm lefthook && sudo ln -sf $(npm config get prefix)/bin/pnpm /usr/local/bin/pnpm && sudo ln -sf $(npm config get prefix)/bin/lefthook /usr/local/bin/lefthook && sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq pipx libpq-dev && pipx install graphifyy && sudo mkdir -p /home/vscode/.config/gh && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.config/gh && lefthook install && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && (cd apps/e2e && pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium)
